FastAPI Quickstart

FastAPI makes building APIs simple and fast.

Install

Install FastAPI and Uvicorn with pip:

pip install fastapi uvicorn

Hello World

Create a tiny app:

from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/")
def read_root():
    return {"hello": "world"}

Run

Start the app with uvicorn and reload on changes.

uvicorn app:app --reload
